corrections.reason: Both visually on the page and grammatically in Amharic (gerundive ጠርጥረውኝ across the line wrap), the final character on line 19 is first-order ረ, not fourth-order ራ.
In the patristic Ge'ez citation (ሶቤሃ ከሠተ ሎሙ), the verb is the 3rd person masculine singular perfective ከሠተ ('he revealed to them'), and the printed glyph is first-order ከ rather than sixth-order ክ.
